reference_boundary: The reference annotates flavone synthase I with a generic flavanone Rhea10448 reaction and cites PMID11524111 and PMID12782296. Exact Cannabis activity is not established by this annotation.
finding: All three highest-bit-score Cannabis hits have an automated naringenin,2-oxoglutarate 3-dioxygenase annotation. A0A7J6GGF7 additionally carries a Fragment flag. These annotations do not experimentally prove an alternative activity, but preclude equating the highest homology scores with exact flavone synthase specificity.
next_tests: Compare against characterized flavanone 3-hydroxylase references, preserving original FNS-I hits and full sequence coverage.
Inspect discriminating substrate-positioning residues separately from broadly conserved Fe/2-oxoglutarate sites.
Assay naringenin conversion with authentic apigenin and dihydrokaempferol standards to distinguish desaturation from hydroxylation; retain no-enzyme and cofactor controls.
claim_boundary: Annotation-guided experimental prioritization only; no protein activity, physiological direction, or net-route rescue assigned. Do not transfer FNS-II cofactor chemistry or drop fragment and WGS cautions.
